seo.title: About WOLFLAG: Custom Flag & Banner Manufacturer in China
seo.description: WOLFLAG is a leading China manufacturer of custom flags and banners, and an official flag supplier to the China Government. Factory-direct wholesale.

items.text: The Source Manufacturer Behind Global Sign Shops & Display Brands

blocks.text:
**WOLFLAG** is the China's leading manufacturer and supplier of flags, banners, bunting, flagpoles, exhibition stands, temporary signage and promotional displays. We are also Official Flag Suppliers to the China Government. Using our extensive experience, a wide range of materials including PVC, knitted polyester, canvas, vinyl and paper, and the latest in printing technology, we help businesses to get noticed with creative, eye catching and high impact promotional and advertising solutions.

Whether you're organising a product launch or promotional campaign, running an event or attending an exhibition or ensuring your corporate image is displayed to maximum effect, WOLFLAG's complete, customer focused service and varied, yet concentrated, product range, will provide you with a professional display solution suited to your environment, brand image and budget.

Our foreign trade sales headquarters is located in Hangzhou (**Hangzhou Loyal Import & Export Co., Ltd**) and boasts an excellent sales team, offering highly experienced services to global flag purchasers. With other two offices in Jiaxing and Yuyao we are always on hand to discuss your requirements and advise on the right solution for you. From design and print at our Jiaxing site, to deliver to your site, your flag, flag pole, banner, building wrap or promotional display order will be project managed from start to finish.

We, as a factory, ship our products directly to you with very low shipping cost. There are no distributors or "middle-men" involved, so you get the lowest price each and every time you buy. This will save you money compared to your local shop.

A wide range of national flags, table flags, flag poles, bunting and hand wavers are available from our website. If for any reason you are unable to find exactly what you are looking for, call one of our knowledgeable customer service representatives who will be happy to assist.

items.text: WOLFLAG was founded in 2003 in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China — the start of our journey as a professional flag and banner manufacturer.
We are honored to have been a supplier of flags and flagpoles for the 2004 **Athens Olympic Games**.
We achieved great success in producing a large number of high-quality flags and flagpoles for the **World Cup in Germany**.
Official flag supplier for the 2008 **Beijing Olympic Games**.
Official flag supplier for the 2010 **Shanghai World Expo** and the 2010 **Guangzhou Asian Games**.
Official flag supplier for the 2011 **Shenzhen Universiade**.
We are very honored to have become a supplier of flags for the 2012 **London Summer Olympic Games**.We were also honored to be one of the flag suppliers for President Obama’s presidential campaign.
Official flag supplier for the 2014 **Nanjing Youth Olympic Games** and we provided a large quantity of various high-quality flags and fan merchandise for the **2014 FIFA World Cup** in Brazil.
It is a great honor for us to have been a supplier of premium flags for the **Rio de Janeiro Summer Olympics**.
Official Designated Manufacturer of Flags for the **Beijing Expo**.
Official flag supplier for the 2022 **Beijing Winter Olympic Games**.
Official flag supplier for the 2023 **Hangzhou Asian Games**.
We successfully supplied high-quality flags and flagpoles for the **Paris Summer Olympics**.

blocks.title: Our Clients
blocks.subtitle: We bring solutions to make business easier for our customers.

items.q: Q. I have no experience with sourcing from Chinese factories or international trade. Can you help me?
items.a: Rest assured, we are here to guide you every step of the way! We’ll help you smoothly customize your products and ensure they arrive at your location safely and on schedule. We have rich professional experience in cross-border trade, including chartering, sea/air shipping, and customs clearance. Our sales reps speak excellent English, majored in International Trade, and bring 10+ years of hands-on experience. We're always happy to help with any questions or concerns!

items.q: Q. What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: For flags and banners, our minimum order is only 3 pieces, so you can customize them with great flexibility. Plus, the more you order, the better the price! As for flagpoles and display hardware, the MOQ is around 300 pieces. Please contact our staff for more details!

items.q: Q. What is your production lead time for custom flags?
items.a:
Sample orders usually take 5–7 working days.
Bulk custom flag orders take about 15–25 working days.
For large-volume orders, the production schedule is confirmed based on your quantity and requirements.

items.q: Q. What file formats do you accept for custom flag artwork?
items.a:
We accept CorelDRAW (.cdr), Adobe Illustrator (.ai), Adobe Photoshop (.psd), .eps, and high-resolution .pdf files.
For best print results, please send vector files or 300 DPI PDFs.
Contact us if you need an artwork template or a free proof.

items.q: Q. Will the custom flag colors match my monitor?
items.a:
Monitor colors can vary, so printed colors may not match your screen exactly.
For accurate color matching, please provide a Pantone (PMS) code or CMYK values.
Contact us if you need a color proof before production.

items.q: Q. What size and resolution should custom flag artwork be?
items.a:
We recommend preparing your artwork at least 25% of the final print size, and 50% is preferred for the best print quality.
If you are unsure about the artwork size or resolution, contact us and we'll check it for free.

items.q: Q. Do you accept RGB files for custom flag printing?
items.a:
We prefer CMYK files for accurate color reproduction.
If your artwork is in RGB format, we can convert it to CMYK for you. A small conversion fee may apply.
Contact us if you need help preparing print-ready files.

items.q: Q. Do you offer private label services for custom flags?
items.a:
Yes. We offer OEM and private label manufacturing for distributors, importers, and brand owners.

Private label services:
• Custom woven or printed brand labels
• Retail-ready packaging with your logo
• Custom barcode printing and application
• Branded header cards and polybags
• Neutral export cartons on request

All production is in-house for consistent branding, stable quality, and supply chain confidentiality.

items.q: Q. Do you offer international shipping for custom flags and banners?
items.a:
Yes. We ship custom flags and banners to the USA, Canada, the UK, Europe, Australia, and other global markets.

Shipping options include:
• Express courier (DHL / FedEx / UPS)
• Air freight
• Sea freight (FCL / LCL)

FOB terms are standard. We also support export documentation and can coordinate door-to-door or port-to-port logistics based on your order volume and delivery timeline.
Contact us with your delivery address for a shipping quote.
